name: CloudsmithCliSetupAndAuthenticate
description: Installs the standalone Cloudsmith CLI and configures API key or Azure DevOps OIDC authentication.
helpMarkDown: For OIDC, map Azure DevOps' short-lived $(System.AccessToken) job token as SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN in the task environment. This is not a user-managed PAT. For issues, contact: support@cloudsmith.io
author: Cloudsmith Ltd (support@cloudsmith.io)

inputs.name: cliVersion
inputs.label: Cloudsmith CLI version
inputs.helpMarkDown: CLI version to install (for example '1.20.0'), or 'latest'. Pin a version for reproducible pipelines.

inputs.name: installDirectory
inputs.label: Installation directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Root directory for versioned CLI installations. Defaults to 'cloudsmith-cli' under the agent tools directory.

inputs.name: authMethod
inputs.label: Authentication method
inputs.helpMarkDown: 'apiKey' exports a secret CLOUDSMITH_API_KEY variable. 'oidc' configures the CLI to exchange the Azure DevOps OIDC token itself; it requires mapping SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN to $(System.AccessToken).

inputs.name: oidcNamespace
inputs.label: Cloudsmith organization
inputs.helpMarkDown: Cloudsmith organization (namespace) to authenticate against. Required for OIDC.

inputs.name: oidcServiceSlug
inputs.label: Cloudsmith service account slug
inputs.helpMarkDown: Cloudsmith service account slug to authenticate as. Required for OIDC.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: Cloudsmith API key
inputs.helpMarkDown: Cloudsmith API key. Store it in a secret pipeline variable, for example $(CLOUDSMITH_API_KEY).

inputs.name: verifyAuth
inputs.label: Verify authentication
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run 'cloudsmith whoami' after installation to verify authentication.

inputs.name: exportAuthToken
inputs.label: Export authentication token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Resolve credentials with 'cloudsmith credential-helper generic'. Export the password as the secret variable CLOUDSMITH_API_KEY and the username as CLOUDSMITH_USERNAME. With OIDC, this is the exchanged Cloudsmith token. Requires Cloudsmith CLI 1.21.0 or later.

outputVariables.name: target
outputVariables.description: Resolved platform target, for example linux-x86_64-gnu.

outputVariables.name: cliPath
outputVariables.description: Absolute path to the cloudsmith executable.

outputVariables.name: binDirectory
outputVariables.description: Directory containing the cloudsmith executable (prepended to PATH).
